_comment: Real mail shapes from a live jobs mailbox, with every employer, person and role renamed. The wording is what matters here and is kept verbatim — the contractions, the typographic apostrophes, the boilerplate an employer buries a rejection inside. Each case says what the gate should make of it: ack (an application was acknowledged), outcome (a decision arrived), or none (an alert, a digest, a match suggestion — never a row). Add a case whenever a real email is classified wrongly; that is the bug report.

cases.body: Hi Rich, Thank you for applying to the role of Product Designer: Design Systems (12 month FTC) at the Rivermead Group. We appreciate the time and energy you invested in applying for our job opening. After careful consideration, we regret to inform you that we have decided to proceed with other candidates who better meet the requirements for this role.
